response.text:
I can do that. A few quick clarifying questions so I update the right event and avoid mistakes:

1. Which Friday do you mean? (this coming Friday, a specific date, or every Friday?)
2. Is the design review a single event or part of a recurring series? If recurring, do you want to move just one occurrence or the whole series?
3. Duration and time zone: how long should it be (default I’ll keep the current duration)? Which time zone should I use (your calendar default if unspecified)?
4. Attendees: update invitations for all current attendees (default), or only inform a subset?
5. Conferencing and reminders: add/update a video conference link and keep or set a 15‑minute reminder?  
6. Permission: may I access your calendar now and (a) reschedule the event to the suggested time, (b) update the event details, and (c) send the updated invitations?

If you want me to pick a sensible time, I suggest one of:
- 3:00–4:00 PM (recommended)
- 2:00–3:00 PM
- 4:00–5:00 PM

Tell me which Friday (or say “this Friday”), which of the three times you prefer (or “pick 3pm”), and confirm the permissions above — then I’ll proceed.
